strings.TITLE: Bounce
strings.HELP_GOAL: Guide the ball past many obstacles to pass through all the hoops and open the door to the next level.
strings.HELP_KEYS: Use key 4 to move the ball left, key 6 to move the ball right and key 2 to bounce the ball.
strings.HELP_SIZE: Use deflators to shrink the ball and inflators to return to normal size. Large balls float in water, small balls don’t.
strings.HELP_CRYSTALS: Collect crystals for extra points and to store your game position. Collect crystal balls to give your ball an extra life.
strings.HELP_BOOSTS: Jump and speed boosts temporarily boost your powers while rubber floors give you extra bounce.
